title: The Ambassador's Daily Mystery; the Five Works of Fire; the Twelve Zodia
description: The cycle now seen as fruitful structure. T68 — the two mysteries shown daily in the same illumining wisdom: the going-forth at dawn that scatters every claimed thing, the gathering at dusk that draws what is the Lord's into the full image of completion. T69 — the five works of love in the natural mind: it consumes whatever is laid on it, draws four things from one (fire, light, smoke, vapor), gives savor to whatever is cooked in it, shapes every vessel by its operation, manifests a light by which the soul sees. T70 — the complete circuit of states the soul cycles through under self-love (twelve fixed conditions and five wandering particulars, all forms of the self), and the Lord's economy by which sun and moon, though numbered with the zodia, are not reckoned of them but stand by his providence within them.
